description.value: Pallet Coffee Roasters is a community-minded Vancouver specialty coffee roastery established in East Vancouver in 2014, now operating eight cafes across Metro Vancouver including this Broadway location. The company roasts its own beans and serves coffee alongside food and freshly baked goods, with both indoor and outdoor seating available. As a full-service roastery and cafe operator, it offers a welcoming stop with a strong local identity for cyclists passing through the Broadway corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Pallet Coffee Roasters is an active, multi-location specialty coffee roastery and cafe chain with 8 Vancouver locations; the OSM record maps to the 'PALLET BROADWAY' location at 2002 West Broadway. The website's contact page lists a head office phone (604 255 2017) and head office address (395 Alexander Street), which differ from the OSM Broadway cafe address — flagged as a concern. No bike-specific facilities, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; the phone listed (604 255 2017) is the corporate head office number from the website, not a number specific to the Broadway cafe location.
